title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1970-02-02
lineage: SBD > Bill Gadsen Reels > C > DAT > WAV > SHN

ai_review.summary: A polarizing soundboard recording that many hail as a transcendent Dark Star performance, while others deem the audio quality terrible.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this show’s superb musicianship—especially an extended, soaring Dark Star—and describe it as one of the band’s most intuitive performances. The recording itself divides opinion: some listeners love its distinctive Fox‑system acoustics and claim it sounds “spot on,” whereas others call it the worst sounding board in the archive.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical praise (especially for Dark Star) raises the rating, but starkly conflicting comments on sound quality pull it toward the middle of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note a unique Fox‑system acoustic signature – some find it perfect for Dark Star, while others describe the board as muddy and indistinct, likening it to “a cockroach’s ears in a concrete pipe.”

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for its seamless flow and four consecutive Garcia songs, with Dark Star highlighted as an especially transcendent centerpiece.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone and interplay are repeatedly described as perfect and utterly transcendent.
